recentItems.title: WTAJ News (2/3/23, 4/5/5:30/6pm Full Shows) - Joe Murgo Signs Off After 22 Years
recentItems.description:
For the first time on this channel, I am posting some full newscasts. And it starts with the departure of, in my opinion, the best meteorologist in the market.

After 22 years with the station, WTAJ's Chief Meteorologist, Joe Murgo, has left the station (and broadcasting) for a new career path. Joe Murgo was the lone remaining on air personality remaining from before Nexstar ownership (Nexstar bought WTAJ in 2006 alongside Harrisburg's then-CW affiliate WLYH 15 (now WXBU, owned by Howard Stirk Holdings and affiliated with Sinclair's TBD network)

I'd say that they gave a decent sendoff to Joe, with the standard bunch of farewell messages and the appearance of family in the studio (along with former anchors Carolyn Donaldson and John Clay).

This video includes the 4pm (not a full hour, Inside Edition is aired at 4:30, despite already having a spot at 7:00pm), 5, 5:30, and 6pm shows.

These shows were recorded over the air from about 30 miles away from the transmitter. The signal was not perfect on this day, so there are multiple moments of signal breakup throughout.

Anchor: Maggie Smolka
Weather: Chief Meteorologist Joe Murgo
Sports: Sports Director Andrew Clay
Reporters: Courtney Murphy, Maria Cade, Raquel Martin (Nexstar Washington, D.C. Bureau), Alyssa Royster, Tristan Klinefelter, Hannah Brandt (Nexstar Washington, D.C. Bureau)

PRESENTATION DETAILS
Graphics: CBS-1 package by Nexstar's Nashville Design Center
Music: 'Convergence' by Stephen Arnold Music (the station's former music package 'Metropolis' by S.A.M. is retained for the Forecast First segments)
Voiceover: Eric Gordon

Commercial breaks were edited to leave in only station promos and IDs

EDITOR'S NOTE: Due to copyright concerns, three CBS News reports were edited out of this upload. All three aired during the 4pm half hour.
